pass3_report.report_title: AI ROI Attribution & Cost Optimization Report — Nexus Digital Solutions

executive_summary.headline: Nexus Can Reduce AI Spending 23% While Improving ROI Performance
executive_summary.overview_paragraph: Nexus Digital Solutions currently spends $193,044 annually on AI across 6 projects, with only 3 of 4 active projects delivering strong ROI. This analysis identifies $43,560 in annual savings opportunities through tool consolidation, model optimization, and elimination of redundant subscriptions. The company's AI portfolio shows promise but suffers from shadow AI proliferation and insufficient governance controls.
executive_summary.key_finding_1: $31,560 in annual waste from redundant tools and unused subscriptions across departments
executive_summary.key_finding_2: Marketing delivers highest AI ROI (85 score) while Engineering underperforms (48.5 average)
executive_summary.key_finding_3: Model optimization alone can reduce LLM costs by $9,360 annually without quality impact
executive_summary.bottom_line: Nexus can achieve 23% cost reduction while strengthening AI governance to prevent future waste.

current_state_analysis.narrative: Nexus Digital Solutions operates a diverse AI portfolio spanning customer support, sales intelligence, content generation, and engineering assistance. The company spends $16,087 monthly across 6 projects using multiple providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS Bedrock), but significant inefficiencies plague the current approach. Tool redundancy is extensive, with overlapping functionality in customer support (Intercom AI + Zendesk AI), content generation (Jasper AI + Claude), and knowledge management systems. The Finance team maintains an unused $1,500/month Runway subscription with zero utilization, representing pure waste. Project performance varies dramatically, from Marketing's exceptional 85 ROI score to Engineering's concerning 48.5 average across two projects.

roi_attribution_detail.narrative: ROI attribution was calculated using a comprehensive methodology combining direct cost attribution (LLM usage + subscriptions + team allocation) with quantified business outcomes measured against baseline KPIs. Each project's cost per outcome unit was calculated by dividing total monthly costs by achieved business metrics (tickets resolved, content pieces created, deals qualified, etc.). ROI scores reflect the relationship between investment and measurable business value creation, weighted for strategic alignment and risk factors.

54% faster resolution time, 52% autonomous resolution rate, $10.30 savings per ticket

underperformers.recommendation: Optimize model selection and reduce engineering overhead

optimization_recommendations.narrative: The optimization strategy focuses on three core areas: immediate elimination of waste through subscription cancellations, tactical model optimization for cost efficiency, and strategic consolidation of redundant tools. These recommendations can be implemented with minimal business disruption while establishing better governance controls to prevent future inefficiencies. The approach prioritizes quick wins that deliver immediate savings while building foundation for long-term AI cost management.

implementation_roadmap.narrative: The implementation follows a three-phase approach designed to maximize early wins while minimizing operational disruption. Phase 1 focuses on immediate cancellations and simple optimizations that require minimal technical work. Phase 2 involves tool consolidations with careful migration planning and team training. Phase 3 establishes long-term governance frameworks to prevent future waste and optimize ongoing AI investments.

risk_and_governance.narrative: The current lack of centralized AI governance has enabled shadow AI proliferation, resulting in the $2,630 monthly redundant spend identified. Without proper controls, this waste will continue growing as more teams independently adopt AI tools. The recommended governance framework includes mandatory approval workflows, real-time cost monitoring, and standardized ROI measurement to prevent future inefficiencies while maintaining innovation velocity.

A/B testing validation and continuous quality monitoring dashboards

appendix.methodology_note: This analysis combines direct cost attribution through API usage tracking and subscription auditing with quantified business outcome measurement against baseline KPIs. ROI calculations include full-cost accounting of team allocation and infrastructure expenses.
appendix.data_quality_note: Analysis based on 3-month usage patterns with high confidence in cost attribution (87.7% of spend directly attributable to specific projects).
appendix.pricing_assumptions: LLM pricing based on December 2024 public rates: OpenAI GPT-4o ($5/$15 per 1M tokens), Anthropic Claude-3.5-Sonnet ($3/$15), AWS Bedrock 20-25% below direct API pricing.
